question: Select the most appropriate word to fill blank no. 8
solution:
The correct answer is '**emerge**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a form becoming visible right before the friends' eyes.
 
• The correct word should convey the idea of something coming into view or becoming apparent.
 
• "**Emerge**" fits perfectly as it means to come into view or become apparent.
 
• Other options ("**assume**", "**derive**", "**extract**") do not convey the correct idea of something becoming visible.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The door behind them was **sealed__**. There was no escape. A strange light was **__emanating__** from a corner, one that did not **__illuminate__** the room but made darkness visible. **__An__** alien voice was heard which sounded like jargon, **__incomprehensible__** to the hapless friends. They went down **__on__** their knees sobbing, pleading for their lives but the **__bizarre__** sounds continued. Slowly, a form seemed to **__emerge__** right before their eyes which **__froze__** their blood and chilled their **__spines__**. It was a formless mass with no face!*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Emerge (उभरना): "Emerge" means to come into view or become apparent, fitting well with the context of something becoming visible.
 
• Assume (मान लेना): "Assume" means to take on or adopt, which does not fit the context of something becoming visible.
 
• Derive (प्राप्त करना): "Derive" means to obtain or extract from a source, which does not fit the context here.
 
• Extract (निकालना): "Extract" means to remove or take out, which does not fit the context of something becoming visible.
